steps.description: First a BFS from hit that records each word's level (its position in a shortest sequence). hit is level 1.
Poll hit at level 1. Any listed word one letter away is at level 2.
hit -> hot: hot gets level 2.
Poll hot at level 2. Any listed word one letter away is at level 3.
hot -> dot: dot gets level 3.
hot -> lot: lot gets level 3.
Poll dot at level 3. Any listed word one letter away is at level 4.
dot -> dog: dog gets level 4.
Poll lot at level 3. Any listed word one letter away is at level 4.
lot -> log: log gets level 4.
Poll dog at level 4. Any listed word one letter away is at level 5.
dog -> cog: cog gets level 5.

variables.map: {lot=3, hit=1, log=4, dot=3, cog=5, hot=2, dog=4}

steps.description: Poll log at level 4. Any listed word one letter away is at level 5.

variables.map: {lot=3, hit=1, log=4, dot=3, cog=5, hot=2, dog=4}

steps.description: Polled cog at level 5: every shortest ladder has minSteps = 5 words. Stop the BFS.

variables.map: {lot=3, hit=1, log=4, dot=3, cog=5, hot=2, dog=4}

steps.description: solve(cog): the list [cog] holds 1 of 5 words. Look for a word one letter away with a smaller level.
dog (level 4) is one letter from cog (level 5): step back to it.
solve(dog): the list [cog, dog] holds 2 of 5 words. Look for a word one letter away with a smaller level.
dot (level 3) is one letter from dog (level 4): step back to it.
solve(dot): the list [cog, dog, dot] holds 3 of 5 words. Look for a word one letter away with a smaller level.
hot (level 2) is one letter from dot (level 3): step back to it.
solve(hot): the list [cog, dog, dot, hot] holds 4 of 5 words. Look for a word one letter away with a smaller level.
hit (level 1) is one letter from hot (level 2): step back to it.
solve(hit): the list holds 5 words - a full ladder.
Reverse it into hit -> hot -> dot -> dog -> cog and add it to res.
log (level 4) is one letter from cog (level 5): step back to it.
solve(log): the list [cog, log] holds 2 of 5 words. Look for a word one letter away with a smaller level.
lot (level 3) is one letter from log (level 4): step back to it.
solve(lot): the list [cog, log, lot] holds 3 of 5 words. Look for a word one letter away with a smaller level.
hot (level 2) is one letter from lot (level 3): step back to it.
solve(hot): the list [cog, log, lot, hot] holds 4 of 5 words. Look for a word one letter away with a smaller level.
hit (level 1) is one letter from hot (level 2): step back to it.
solve(hit): the list holds 5 words - a full ladder.
Reverse it into hit -> hot -> lot -> log -> cog and add it to res.

variables.res: hit -> hot -> dot -> dog -> cog; hit -> hot -> lot -> log -> cog

steps.description: Return res: 2 shortest ladders.

variables.res: hit -> hot -> dot -> dog -> cog; hit -> hot -> lot -> log -> cog
